svg.title: Depth sensor post-processing: six stages
svg.desc: Six post-processing stages in two columns. The three renderer outputs used as inputs are blue; the five depth-sensor outputs are green. DepthSensorImager is produced by stage 1. Stage 6 writes the distance and visualization outputs and applies the confidence result from stage 2 to the depth and point-cloud entries.
svg.text: pixels; the result is kept per
what the stage discards or zeroes
